hero.title: Protect Your Crops with Instant AI Disease Detection
hero.subtitle: Snap a photo of any diseased leaf. Our deep learning computer vision model identifies the pathogen, measures affected severity, and prescribes certified organic and chemical treatments tailored to your region.

steps.title: How AgriVision Works in 3 Simple Steps
steps.step1_desc: Take a photo of the affected plant leaf with your smartphone camera or upload from gallery.
steps.step2_desc: MobileNetV2 neural network detects the crop and disease, while OpenCV calculates affected leaf severity %.
steps.step3_desc: Receive verified organic remedies, chemical active ingredients with safety intervals, and weather alerts.
